title: Game FAQ
summary_body: Although there are many different playing styles, the game mostly revolves around collecting and breeding animals and taking care of your zoo. You can also design and decorate along the way and enjoy the many special events and prizes every month. You can connect with other players and team up with them in a guild to earn rewards. There are lots of quests to complete and items to collect, but many players agree that patience is the way to play this game long term. This game does not require real money to progress or enjoy it, but it is an optional track if you want extra perks or to get things faster. Upjers makes lots of animals and currency available for free to engaged players. App users can also enable Bonus Offer Ads (optional) to earn bonuses, discounts, or timer reductions without spending money.
levelup_body: You can level up by earning XP (experience points). You receive XP from cleaning your zoo, helping your friends, breeding, completing achievements and quests, and placing new deco, enclosures, or animals. Leveling up gives rewards that often help you complete a quest. To level up faster, place lots of high XP-generating animals in your zoo. You can coin feed them blue feed to receive double XP. Activate a club fundraiser XP bonus of up to 10% depending on the club. If you play on the mobile app, watch an ad to activate a one-hour 10% XP boost as often as every 24 hours — it applies to all XP generated.
focus_intro: Some future tasks to consider working toward:
focus_tip_1: Prioritize breeding your pandas to level 10.
focus_tip_2: Immediately complete any pink hibiscus bushes from a single puzzle piece as soon as you get it. Leave it in your inventory and do not place it in your zoo until after you receive the quest to place 10 pink hibiscus bushes.
focus_tip_3: If you would like to maximize the free Zoo Academy voucher you receive at level 10, prioritize completing Madame Yu tasks every 6 hours to reach level 14 of the academy and maximize your Bronze membership before redeeming the voucher.
focus_tip_4: If you still only have one or two regions by Level 93, consider stopping trash collection about 24 hours before leveling up to Level 94 to ensure you have enough trash for a timed task that gives 5 diamonds.
focus_tip_5: After Level 100, you unlock a quest requiring you to open 50 retro and 50 legendary chests starting from the time you receive the quest. You can collect free chests from the calendar and if you have enough coins during an event, collect all the event chests.
scrap_body: When scrapping items, it is generally best practice at lower levels to scrap only coin items. Exceptions include the Mountain Gorilla (not available in the shop) and some animals that only unlock at very high levels, such as the African Buffalo or the Argali. Try not to open a diamond chest unless you have enough keys (4) to get the guaranteed animal you need if you are short on chests.

bulldozer.title: Bulldozer
bulldozer.intro: The Bulldozer is a decoration selection tool available for purchase from level 25. It can be unlocked for 50 diamonds or 500,000 coins and requires energy to operate. The tool can select up to 500 decorations at once to return them to inventory or move them in their retained grouping across your current zoo region.
bulldozer.overview_body: When items are returned to inventory, they do not retain their grouped form but are stacked as individual items. The Bulldozer can only pick up items classified as decorations, such as plants, statues, restrooms, etc. It cannot pick up trash cans, paths, buildings, enclosures, enclosure decorations, NPCs, or terrain pieces.
bulldozer.event_body: During a seasonal event, the event decorations that generate currency can only be selected with the Bulldozer after the entire event has fully concluded.
bulldozer.energy_body: Energy can be obtained with diamonds, as quest rewards, as a free gift from the monthly login reward path, or with the Prize Wheel.

visitors.title: Visitor Level
visitors.intro: The visitor level is in all likelihood the most important aspect of the game. The visitor level of a zoo indicates how many visitors are currently coming to your zoo. The higher the number, the more visitors — which of course means more coins collected not only at the entrance gate but also at all your shops. Your current visitor level is shown to the right of your zoo level in the top left of the screen. Tapping the visitor level display brings up a popup showing your level, the visitor points needed for the next level, and suggestions for what your visitors would like to see in your zoo.
visitors.modifiers_intro: There are many factors that influence the visitor level. Unlike the experience level, your zoo's visitor level is dynamic and fluctuating. While most effects are positive, there are also negative modifiers that decrease your visitor level.
visitors.animals_body: Animals have a large positive influence. In general, the more expensive the animal, the more visitor points you receive. There is no difference between female and male animals. However, baby animals have a double visitor points bonus (this drops to the normal adult value when the baby grows up after 7 days). An animal's visitor points decrease through unhappiness. Animals without food, without sufficient playtime, or in a dirty enclosure have reduced visitor points. Feeding, playing, and cleaning the enclosure restores visitor points fully. There are also special buildings and an animal keeper that keep animals automatically at 100% happiness.
visitors.decorations_intro: Decorations are your most important means of adding and boosting visitor points. They do not need to be placed on paths. The more expensive the decoration, the more points are generally added (exception: club shop decorations cost more but give fewer overall visitor points). There are different types of decorations:
visitors.plants_body: Plants come in various types but function the same for visitor level purposes. Plants give a bonus for each planted object. However, like animals, they need to be maintained — plants will eventually wilt and their visitor points decrease. Watering the plants restores their full point value. There is a gardener for gems who automatically waters a certain number of plants.
visitors.enclosure_deco_body: Enclosure decorations are placed inside animal enclosures. They do not affect the animal's happiness but do provide popularity points for visitors. Unlike plants outside enclosures, enclosure plant decorations do not wilt. The enclosure must be connected to a path for its contents (animals and enclosure decorations) to contribute to your popularity points. Disconnected enclosures contribute no popularity points.
visitors.object_deco_body: Decorations outside enclosures include everything from benches and fountains to signs and playgrounds. They do not need to be maintained or connected to a path to provide popularity points.
visitors.bathrooms_body: Restrooms do not need to be placed on paths to have an effect and do not need to be maintained.
visitors.trash_body: Trash is dropped in your zoo when there are not enough trash cans that visitors can reach on paths. Trash cans do not give a direct positive visitor bonus, but allow visitors to deposit trash there instead of throwing it on the paths. Trash on paths causes your visitors to leave the zoo faster but does not directly affect popularity points. There is a garbage collector for gems who automatically collects a limited amount of trash for you.
visitors.npcs_body: Special Guests (NPCs) walk on the paths of your zoo. They take up no space, do not affect animal happiness, do not need to be maintained, and exclusively provide popularity points for visitors.

friends.title: Friends
friends.intro: Players can earn rewards from two different types of friends: recruited friends and in-game friends. Recruited friends are invited users who have never played Zoo 2 before, while in-game friends are existing players whose accounts can be linked to yours.
friends.recruited_body: You can earn rewards for recruiting new players to Zoo 2 with your personal invitation link. Click the pink "Invite" button in your recruit friends window and send the link to new players. The new player must use your link to download the game and complete up to 5 objectives for you to earn friendship coins. Note: This feature is not available for Steam or Epic Games players.
friends.objective_animals: Have 10 animals total in the zoo
friends.objectives_note: Each completed objective from a recruited friend gives you 1 friendship coin. If a recruited friend completes the same objective twice, there are no additional coins.
friends.ingame_body: Players can have up to 16 in-game friends. Since friends share certain rewards, it is very advantageous to have active in-game friends. Note: As part of a fair-play rule, it violates Upjers' Terms of Service to have in-game friends who use the same internet connection.
friends.adding_body: To add new in-game friends, you must accept a friend request or send one to an existing player. Tap the friends menu icon and select a free friendship slot to see 12 suggested players at a similar level. To add a specific player, use the search tool and enter their Support ID.
friends.removing_body: To free up a friendship slot, select a friend and tap the trash bin in their info area. The slot will be locked for 24 hours before you can invite again or accept invitations. Getting and keeping 16 active friends is difficult, and players often have to resort to other means, such as social media or forums.
friends.zoo_details_body: When you tap on a friend, you see information about their zoo progress: zoo titles held, number of park expansions, number of different animal species, number of animals at level 10 or above, number of achievements, and the number of placed baby animals currently growing up in the main zoo.
friends.helping_body: Helping requires a visit to your friend's zoo. Tap the heart in the friends list or the help-a-friend button. Helping gives both players a friendship heart point plus XP. Per helped friend you receive XP equal to ten times your current player level. You can click the "jump to" shortcut button at the bottom of your helping friends screen to find the next crow, child, or animal instantly. Use social media to find active daily helpers for more friendship chests. They only need your Support ID (found in settings). App users can also watch an ad or pay a diamond to help a friend instead of playing the mini-game.
friends.minigame_crows: Scare away crows: 5 crows are in random enclosures. Tap each crow 3 times to scare it away.
friends.minigame_children: Comfort children: 5 crying children are randomly placed on paths. Give each child a balloon to comfort them.
friends.minigame_animals: Catch animals: 10 animals run randomly on the zoo paths. Sweep the net over each of them.
friends.skip_body: You can help one or all friends instantly by paying diamonds. "Skip help" costs 1 diamond per player. The "Help all" button costs 5 diamonds per remaining unhelped player. App users can also watch an ad to help a friend (limit 20 ads per 24h).
friends.messaging_body: The game provides a private chat box for writing messages to in-game friends. Tap the envelope next to your friend. When a new message arrives, a notification appears next to the friends icon. The envelope changes from grey to yellow for unread messages. Sent messages cannot be deleted or edited.
friends.levelup_body: When you level up, all your in-game friends also receive the level-up gift you select. You also receive the level-up gifts from your friends. You choose one puzzle piece from a random set of 3.
friends.chests_body: Every time you help a friend or are helped by them, you receive one friendship point. Every 10 points reward you with a friendship chest containing puzzle pieces for decorations, enclosures, and enclosure furniture as well as exclusive friendship animals. The maximum is 32 points per day with 16 active friends (3 chests per day). The storage limit is 5 chests.
friends.troubleshooting_body: If your game crashes while helping friends without an error message, your device may have insufficient RAM. Loading large, fully animated zoos requires significant memory. Try the following solutions:
friends.fix_device: Change device: Try helping friends on a device with more RAM, such as a laptop or desktop computer.
friends.fix_friends: Change friends: Remove friends with very large zoos (above level 60) and replace them with lower-level players with smaller zoos that require less RAM.
friends.fix_settings: Adjust game settings: Enable "Reduced Animations", disable "Enhanced Zoom", or enable "Limit Frame Rate" in the second settings tab to reduce RAM usage.

terraineditor.title: Terrain Editor
terraineditor.intro: The Terrain Editor is a ground editing tool that changes the general landscape (the ground) of your zoo regions outside of enclosures. It can be unlocked from player level 25 for a one-time fee of 500,000 coins or 50 diamonds.
terraineditor.overview_body: To operate the Terrain Editor, you need Energy, which you can get from the Prize Wheel or sometimes from the login reward calendar. You can also purchase energy for diamonds. While the editor is not strictly necessary for game progress, an introductory quest offers a small reward. High-level players need this tool for the Mayor Quest "Landscape Architect Zoo", which unlocks from player level 110.
terraineditor.access_body: The Terrain Editor is opened by clicking the brush icon on the left side of the inventory sidebar. There are two landscape-changing features: the Terrain Editor (for outside enclosures) and the Enclosure Floor Editor (for inside enclosures).
terraineditor.visuals_body: Each terrain type is designed for specific biomes or themes: snow suits ice biomes, sand suits savanna areas, stone suits mountain biomes, earth offers a natural look, autumn leaves suit seasonal or plains biomes, water creates natural ponds, and forest provides a woodland floor covering.

video.title: Video Ads
video.intro: Zoo 2 offers two types of video ads for mobile app users: billboard ads that earn diamonds, and bonus offer ads that provide various bonuses, discounts, or timer reductions. Browser ads are only available in limited regions.
video.billboard_body: A billboard to the left of the main entrance allows some platforms to watch short video ads in exchange for diamonds. Watching 10 ads generates 1 diamond at a maximum availability of 20 ads in a 24-hour period. Ad availability may be limited by region, platform, and other factors.
video.redeeming_body: You can redeem diamonds once you reach 10 ads. However, if you save up 1,000 ads before redeeming, the game gives you a 100-diamond package bonus animal. 2,000+ ads earn a pair of premium animals with your 200-diamond redemption. Redeeming 10,000+ ads gives 1,000 diamonds and a single VIP animal or another current VIP offer choice. This bonus animal feature is not guaranteed by Upjers, and early redemptions cannot be undone.
video.availability_body: Billboard ads are limited to 20 per 24-hour period. Each ad starts its own 24-hour timer. Once the daily limit is reached, a timer shows when more ads are available. Devices that can download the app from the Google Play Store should generally offer ads.
video.age_body: The game asks for the player's age in relation to advertising privacy policies. Entering an age of 12 or younger locks the game on the device with the message that the game is not designed for children. Reinstalling the game should prompt the question again.
video.tips_intro: Ad availability is most commonly related to the ad tracking identity. Important: Billboard ads are currently linked to the Bonus Offer Ads setting — make sure you untick "Don't show video offers" in settings to enable all ad features.
video.tip_delay: DELAY: Wait 5 seconds between ads before trying to watch another.
video.tip_restart: RESTART: Sometimes simply restarting the game increases ad availability.
video.tip_internet: SWITCH INTERNET: Try using a different internet connection or mobile data to see if ads become available.
video.tip_device: SWITCH DEVICE: Try watching ads on a different device linked to your Support ID.
video.tip_tracking: RESET TRACKING: For Android, reset Google Ads ID. For iOS, reset by turning tracking off and on.
video.ios_tracking_body: Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. Enable "Allow Apps to Request to Track", then enable the "Zoo 2" app. Restart the game. If doing this for the first time since reinstalling, click the green "Activate" button when clicking to watch ads.
video.ios_reset_body: Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. Disable "Allow Apps to Request to Track" and confirm "Ask Apps to Stop Tracking". Then enable it again and also enable the "Zoo 2" app. Restart the game. You may need to repeat this every time ads stop being available.
video.android_reset_body: Go to Settings > Google > Ads. Tap "Reset Advertising ID" and then OK. Restart the game. You may need to repeat this every time ads stop being available.
video.bonus_body: For mobile app platforms, players can enable video bonus offers in the game settings by unticking "Don't show video offers". Important: If you tap "Don't show video offers" while collecting coins at admission booths, all bonus ads are disabled again. Bonus offers have their own limit of up to 20 ads every 24 hours.
video.xp_bonus_body: This feature unlocks 24 hours after the previous activation. Currently a configuration issue links this bonus to the billboard ad timer, so some players may need to wait until their billboard countdown timer ends. The issue is expected to be fixed in a future update.
video.xp_sources_body: Cleaning enclosures, playing with animals, feeding animals, completing quests, placing new items or animals, releasing animals, helping friends, watering plants, collecting trash, unsuccessful breeding, letting babies grow up, or collecting XP from workers.
video.fertility_body: This breeding boost can only be applied to active breeding attempts. Make sure you have enough time to watch the video fully before the breeding completes, otherwise the bonus will not be applied and the ad will not count toward your limit.
video.video_chests_body: This feature unlocks 24 hours after the previous activation. You must also have enough of your 20-ad bonus limit remaining after the 24-hour wait time.
video.limits_body: The limits for bonus offer ads are separate from your billboard ad limit. Within a 24-hour period you can watch up to 20 bonus offer ads. Each ad starts its own 24-hour timer. If you do not complete an ad, the bonus is not applied and the ad is not counted toward your limit.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Log in every day to collect daily rewards. Log in 25 days in a month to receive two special puzzle piece animals. On days 26–31 there are 1–2 diamonds each. In December, the Advent Calendar replaces the daily login rewards.
calendar.how_it_works_body: Every day you open the game, you collect a daily login reward. The rewards progress along a monthly track. If you log in 25 days in a month, you receive both puzzle piece animals for that month. On days 26 to 31 there are bonus diamonds. The reward track resets at the beginning of a new month. Each month features two special animals (earned as puzzle pieces over 25 login days) and bonus chests awarded along the way.
calendar.advent_body: Each December, the Advent Calendar replaces the daily login reward track. Open a new door every day to collect special rewards. Missed doors can be unlocked until January 7 for 3 diamonds each. In December, tap the calendar bubble in the game to find the door of the day. Each door is only open for 24 hours before it closes. You have until January 7 of the following year to unlock missed doors for 3 diamonds per door.
